items.briefing:
Australian organisations are increasingly adopting AI tools, but a new report warns that many are doing so faster than they are building the skills and policies to use them safely. Separate research highlights that AI security incidents are rising, with criminals finding new ways to exploit AI systems. Analysts at Forrester are urging all organisations to put practical AI governance in place now — not later — to manage these risks before they escalate.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation uses any AI tools, make sure staff know what data they are — and aren't — allowed to enter into them.

featured.title: GitLab 19.4 adds agentic automation & cost controls
featured.summary: Administrators now have tighter oversight as GitLab 19.4 expands AI agent controls, model choice and usage visibility across teams.
